courses.description: Design practical LLM applications with prompting, retrieval, embeddings, tool use, evaluation and safety-aware application patterns.

lessons.title: LLM Application Architecture

lessons.title: Prompt Design & Structured Outputs
lessons.content: Create prompts that produce predictable, machine-usable outputs.

lessons.title: Embeddings & Semantic Retrieval
lessons.content: Represent text for similarity search and retrieve relevant context.

lessons.title: Building a RAG Pipeline
lessons.content: Chunk documents, retrieve evidence and ground model responses in source material.

lessons.title: Tool Use & Agent Loops
lessons.content: Connect models to controlled tools and design bounded agent workflows.

lessons.title: Evaluation, Safety & Reliability
lessons.content: Measure answer quality, detect failures and add practical safeguards.
